$schema.description: Optional URL or path of this JSON Schema, for editors.

tempo.description: Beats per minute; one beat is a quarter note. 100–140 suits most jingles.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

beats.description: Beats (quarter notes at `tempo`) from the start.

length.description: Total length of the audio. Leave room after the last note for it to ring out (and for a voice-over, if any).

seed.description: Seed for every random detail (mallet noise, reverb, humanize). Same score + seed = identical audio.

loudness.description: Target integrated loudness in LUFS. -14 matches YouTube; leave the default unless asked.

fadeOut.description: Seconds of fade at the very end.

limiter.description: Allow a few dB of transparent peak limiting so the jingle reaches the loudness target. Leave it on unless asked.

master.description: Mix settings for the whole jingle.

cues.description: Named moments, e.g. { "hit": { "seconds": 1.5 }, "voice": { "seconds": 1.8 } }. Notes can be placed on them and the timing map reports them.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

beats.description: Beats (quarter notes at `tempo`) from the start.

additionalProperties.description: A named moment the animation syncs to, e.g. { "seconds": 1.5 } for a hit. Give it in seconds when the animation fixes the time, so you never convert seconds to beats yourself. A cue needs no note on it (e.g. where a voice-over starts).

instrument.description: Which built-in instrument or sound effect plays this track. marimba: Wooden bar struck with a soft mallet: warm, round, bouncy. The default for friendly openings, question-and-answer melodies and big chord hits with a low bass. | xylophone: Hard wooden bars, bright and dry with a short ring: quick runs, playful and comedic hits, cartoon energy. | glockenspiel: Small steel bars: bell-like, sparkling, long ring. Magic, twinkles, a logo shine; doubles a melody an octave up at low gain for sparkle. | vibraphone: Metal bars with a shimmering tremolo: smooth, jazzy, calm. Lounge, tech and corporate stings, soft chords. | musicbox: Tiny plucked steel comb: delicate, nostalgic, lullaby-like. Sounds an octave above the written pitch. | piano: Acoustic piano: full, warm, versatile. Chords and melodies for any style; rings about 3 s per note. | organ: Drawbar organ with a gentle wobble: sustained, churchy or retro-funky. Holds each note for its `len`. | ukulele: Nylon-string ukulele, finger-plucked: soft, warm, short ring. Happy vlog and family-channel tunes, gentle strums. | piccolo: Synthetic piccolo/flute: airy, whistling melody line. Sounds an octave above the written pitch. Sounds synthetic, not like a real flute. | trumpet: Synthetic trumpet: bright brass fanfare line. Sounds synthetic, not like a real trumpet. | clap: Hand clap (unpitched). Variants: "studio" (drum-machine clap, the default), "snappy" (tighter, brighter), "hands" (one person, natural), "group" (a few people together). Use `repeat` for claps on every beat. | clock: Clock tick-tock (sound effect). Variants "tick" (default) and "tock"; alternate them with "variant": ["tick", "tock"] and `repeat`. | footsteps: Footsteps (sound effect): heel, toe and scuff of an ordinary shoe. Variants "left" (default) and "right"; walk with "variant": ["left", "right"] and `repeat` every 0.5–1 beat. | heels: High-heel footsteps (sound effect): a sharp clack and the sole after it. Variants "left" (default) and "right"; walk with "variant": ["left", "right"] and `repeat`. | tapdance: Tap-dance taps (sound effect): a dry crack on a wooden floor. Variants "toe" (default), "heel" (lower, heavier), "shuffle" (a brush and a tap). | pistol: Pistol shot (sound effect). Variants "shot" (default: crack and boom) and "cartoon" (a light pop-gun). | laser: Laser zap 'pew' (sound effect): a falling electronic sweep. Optional `pitch` sets where it starts (default about D7); `len` sets the sweep's length (default 0.25 s). | whoosh: Whoosh (sound effect) for transitions and things flying past. Variants "soft" (default) and "fast". `len` sets its length (default 0.5 s); place it with "end" to finish on a cut. | riser: Riser (sound effect): builds up into a hit. Variants "noise" (default) and "tone". Place it by its end: { "end": "hit", "len": 4 } rises for 4 beats and stops exactly on the cue. Default length 2 s. | impact: Impact boom (sound effect) for reveals and big landings. Variants "soft" (default) and "hard". Put it on the cue the animation lands on. | pop: Pop (sound effect): a short bubbly blip for things appearing or text popping in. Optional `pitch` sets where it starts. | knock: Knock on wood (sound effect). Variants "door" (default) and "table". "Knock-knock": two notes about half a beat apart, or `repeat`.

name.description: Optional label for people, e.g. "melody" or "bass".

gain.description: Track level in dB (0 = as is, -6 = about half as loud).

reverb.description: false keeps this track out of the reverb (dry, close effects such as clicks and ticks).

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

at.description: When the note starts: a number of beats from the start (0, 0.5, 1 …); or { "seconds": n }; or a cue name ("hit"); or a cue name with an offset in beats ("hit+1" = one beat after the cue, "hit-0.5" = half a beat before).

end.description: For effects with a length (whoosh, riser, laser): when it ends, instead of `at`. A riser into the hit is { "end": "hit", "len": 4 }.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

pitch.description: A pitch, or a list of pitches for a chord. Required for pitched instruments; leave it out for unpitched ones.

anyOf.description: Scientific pitch notation: "C4" is middle C, "A4" is 440 Hz; sharps "F#3", flats "Bb5".

items.description: Scientific pitch notation: "C4" is middle C, "A4" is 440 Hz; sharps "F#3", flats "Bb5".

chord.description: A chord by name instead of `pitch`: "C", "Am", "G7", "Fmaj7", "Bb", "F#m7", "Dsus4". The instrument voices it: a ukulele plays a real chord shape, other instruments stack it from octave 4. Use `pitch` instead for exact notes.

strum.description: Strum the chord string by string, slightly loose like a real hand. "down" or "up" for one stroke, or a pattern: one character per eighth note, D = down, U = up, d/u = soft, - = rest. "D-DU-UDU" is one 4-beat bar of the classic island strum; combine with `repeat` ({ "every": 4, "count": 2 }) for more bars. A pitch list is strummed in the order written (string order).

grid.description: Beats per pattern character (default 0.5: eighth notes; 0.25 for sixteenths).

vel.description: Velocity 0–1: how hard the note is played (0.8 normal, 1 the big hit, 0.35 a soft echo).

len.description: Length in beats: how long sustained instruments hold, and how long effects with a length (whoosh, riser, laser) last. Struck and plucked instruments ring out and ignore it.

pan.description: Overrides the track's pan for this note: 0 left, 0.5 centre, 1 right.

variant.description: For sounds with variants (listed per instrument). A list cycles over `repeat`s, e.g. ["left", "right"].

every.description: Beats between repetitions (1 = every beat, 0.5 = every eighth note).

count.description: How many times the note sounds in total, including the first.

until.description: Repeat up to and including this time (any `at` form, e.g. a cue). Give `count` or `until`, not both.

seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the jingle.

anyOf.description: A time in seconds, for times the animation fixes ("lands at 1.5 s").

repeat.description: Play the same note repeatedly, e.g. a clock ticking or claps on every beat. Each repetition is its own note in the timing map.

detune.description: Cents (1/100 semitone) to detune this note by.

humanize.description: Up to this many ms of seeded random timing offset. Never moves a note placed exactly on a cue.

items.description: One note or chord (or one sound effect hit).
One instrument's part. Use several tracks for several instruments, or for melody and bass on the same instrument.

description: A jingle: a short piece of music and sound effects, with named cues an animation can sync to.
